depictions.name: Aggalaki Cave
depictions.text: Aggalaki Cave, also known as the Blue Cave, is the largest cave on the Greek island of Kephallonia, located near Mount Ainos. It is part of a larger cave system and houses a small lake. By 431 BCE, the cave had been taken over by a pack of wolves, and sometime later it was explored by the misthios Kassandra.
